name: Harbor View Cafe
evidence_text: Enjoy breakfast on our sunny patio overlooking the marina. Outdoor heaters keep the deck comfortable year-round.

name: Rooftop Gardens

name: Downtown Diner
evidence_text: Cozy indoor booths only. All seating is inside the dining room; we do not offer patio or sidewalk tables.

name: Underground Kitchen
evidence_text: Located in the basement level with no windows or exterior access. Dining is strictly indoors.

name: Lakeside Grill
evidence_text: Outdoor seating available weather permitting. During winter all guests are seated inside.

name: Market Street Eatery
evidence_text: We do not have outdoor dining. Our sidewalk patio opens on warm evenings.

name: Corner Bistro
evidence_text: Italian cuisine. Open Tuesday through Sunday.

name: Quick Bites
evidence_text: Fast casual. Order at the counter.

name: Sunset Lounge
evidence_text: Craft cocktails and small plates. Live music on Fridays.

name: The Noodle House
evidence_text: Delivery and takeout available. Dine-in seating in our main dining hall.

name: Garden Terrace Restaurant
